details:
In recent communities, an increasing number of people are using avatars rated "Very Poor" or higher due to the increasing level of detail in costumes and decorations. However, even within the same "Very Poor" rank, avatar sizes can range from as light as 10MB to over 200MB, resulting in significant differences in actual load.

While the current avatar capacity restrictions have had some effect, they are not the only cause of performance degradation. For example, factors other than capacity, such as the number of material slots and light usage, also have a significant impact. As a result, limiting avatar capacity alone is not enough to adequately manage performance.

We therefore propose that a new rank be established above the current "Very Poor" rank, allowing for restrictions based on more granular criteria. This would enable management based on comprehensive performance indicators rather than just capacity, which we hope will lead to an improved user experience and a more stable environment.
title: Addition of Avatar Performance Rank
